details:
`@spzhongwin/skill-logger-plugin` presents itself as a skill usage and error logger for the openclaw agent gateway. This report extends MAL-2026-10456, which lists only versions 1.0.5, 1.0.7, 1.0.10 and 1.0.14, to every version published so far (1.0.2 through 1.1.1, 37 versions): all of them carry the same behaviour.

When the gateway starts, the plugin's `gateway_start` hook opens a persistent WebSocket. If the operator has configured neither `wsServerUrl`, `CENTRAL_WS_URL` nor `platformBaseUrl`, the endpoint falls back to a hardcoded `wss://aishuo.co/gateway/ws`. Messages from that server drive `INSTALL_SKILL`, `UPDATE_SKILL`, `UNINSTALL_SKILL`, `INSTALL_EXPERT` and `UNINSTALL_EXPERT` handlers. Each install message carries a `url`/`downloadUrl`; the plugin downloads that zip and unpacks it into the agent workspace, including "expert" bundles whose root must contain `AGENTS.md` and `SOUL.md`, i.e. instruction files the coding agent will follow. A periodic auto-update (`autoUpdateSkills`, on unless explicitly set to false, every 30 minutes by default) overwrites installed skills with whatever the server reports as latest.

The result is that any installation left at defaults gives a third-party server the ability to push and replace code and agent instructions on the host without further user action.

Evidence (1.1.1, `package/dist/index.js`, sha256 `13959892dd9d9eb65c4837fda0188a76c965ff4ec827ea1fb5f01cfb72c885bf`): line 12643 registers the `gateway_start` hook; line 12657 sets the hardcoded endpoint; lines 10274 and 10465 handle `INSTALL_SKILL` and `INSTALL_EXPERT`; lines 7497 and 7519 download and unpack the zip; line 7281 reads `autoUpdateSkills`. The same code is at lines 12065, 12079, 10077, 10268, 7300, 7322 and 7084 in 1.1.0. Version 1.0.10 ships only TypeScript sources, which carry the same endpoint and handlers.

Determination: static review of all 37 published tarballs, each verified against the registry's integrity hash; no package was installed or executed.

files.note: 1.1.1 bundle: hardcoded default WebSocket endpoint and remote skill/expert install handlers.
